gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans: Retro in mood and tightly packed, Styro crowds its big lowercase letters almost shut. Noto Sans feels like an opened window beside it, its generous c giving that dense heading room to breathe.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, giving the sans-serif text a clean, contemporary feel. And across a full paragraph, its tall, full c, s and z keep the eye moving, however loudly Styro shouts above.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoined: Plain sans in manner, Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined leaves generous gaps between curve ends and stems, with little height difference between cases. And its easy openness against Styro's crowded, closed letters is the standout.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hier: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs moves briskly, its terminal tips pointing outward and its x-height climbing nearly to cap height. Styro commands attention, while the body text just carries the words.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Dense, retro and loud: Styro packs its big lowercase until the letters nearly fuse. Noto Sans Arabic, all sans-serif openness in its small letters, gives that shout somewhere to land.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Open-tipped curves and a pronounced x-height make this body text feel modern and clean, plain sans through and through. Noto Sans Avestan against Styro's crowded, retro heading is where the pair really stands out.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Tight meets spacious: Styro crams its retro letters together while Noto Sans Balinese gives every curve a breathing space. And its short ascenders keep the text low-profile, leaving the heading all the attention.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Styro crowds its sizable lowercase into a retro, commanding huddle. Noto Sans Bamum opens up every small letter with big counters, and that closed-versus-open split is the whole appeal.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Noto Sans Bassa Vah is plain sans with a dominant midsection and an open-jawed c, like a pair of pliers. Across paragraphs it stays comfortable, even beside Styro's crowded retro heading.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-batak: Crowded and commanding: Styro packs its big retro lowercase tight. Noto Sans Batak, with a towering x-height and an e that never looks squeezed, makes a full page feel approachable.
